Log in to MGnify to access private data

Source: R/v2_client.R
mgnifyLogin.Rd

Log in to MGnify to access private data

Usage

mgnifyLogin(username, password)

Arguments

username

A single character value specifying the Webin username, e.g., "Webin-1122334".

password

A single character value specifying the password.

Value

TRUE invisibly, if login was successful.

Details

Most MGnify data is public and can be fetched without logging in. To access private data, log in with your ENA Webin credentials. The login lasts for the R session, and it is used by all the functions that fetch data from MGnify API v2, such as searchStudies and fetchStudies.

Examples

# Wrong credentials give an error
try(mgnifyLogin("Webin-0", "wrong"))
#> Error : Failed to log in.

# With your own ENA Webin credentials, log in and fetch private data
# mgnifyLogin("Webin-1122334", "SecretPassword")
# tse <- fetchStudies("MGYS00000001")
